intro: Tell apart description, example and opinion in a feature about a cultural practice. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Tell apart description, example and opinion in a feature about a cultural practice. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: relative clauses specify which person or activity the text is about; opinion markers show interpretation. In this passage, «atelier» means «workshop».

frases.estudio: Dans le village de Saint-Loup, des bénévoles organisent chaque été un atelier de fabrication de masques.
frases.alumno: In the village of Saint-Loup, volunteers organise a mask-making workshop every summer.

frases.estudio: Cette tradition, qui se transmet depuis plusieurs générations, attire aussi des visiteurs.
frases.alumno: This tradition, which has been passed on for several generations, also attracts visitors.

frases.estudio: Les participants apprennent à travailler le bois avant de décorer leur création.
frases.alumno: Participants learn to work with wood before decorating their creation.

frases.estudio: Pour la chroniqueuse, ces rencontres préservent un savoir-faire tout en créant des liens entre voisins.
frases.alumno: For the writer, these gatherings preserve a craft skill while creating links between neighbours.
